authority_boundary: Mira Library governs repository-local source-library shelving and retrieval metadata only. It does not verify claims, grant quotation rights, ingest records into the private Archive catalog, publish sources, or import external corpora.

era_definitions.label: Ancient
era_definitions.description: Operational shelf for classical, foundational, and ancient subject periods up to the 476 AD boundary.

era_definitions.label: Medieval
era_definitions.description: Operational shelf for medieval subject periods, transmission chains, religious-political orders, and civilizational continuity from 476 AD to 1453 AD.

era_definitions.label: Colonial
era_definitions.description: Operational shelf for early-modern subject periods from 1453 AD to 1815 AD, including imperial, maritime, gunpowder-state, confessional, company-rule, and pre-industrial global systems; not limited to European colonial history.

era_definitions.label: Industrial
era_definitions.description: Operational shelf for industrial subject periods from 1815 AD to 1991 AD, including industrial states, mass politics, late empire, world wars, Cold War order, and modern state capacity.

era_definitions.label: Digital
era_definitions.description: Operational shelf for digital-era subject periods from 1991 AD to present, including post-Cold War order, internet-scale information systems, platform media, globalization, precision warfare, AI, and digital state capacity.
